question: Who is known as the father of the green revolution in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norman Borlaug.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Norman Borlaug:-**

 
 
• **The "Father of the Green Revolution" is typically attributed to an American agronomist named Norman Borlaug.**
 
• Borlaug was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1970 in recognition of his contributions to world peace through increasing food supply.
